title: DeepMisconceptionVivaQASchema
description: Schema for Modality 2: Viva Questions and Answers

session_id.description: Identifier linking to the parent programming session

viva_id.description: Unique identifier for this viva Q&A turn

question.description: Viva question grounded in the submitted Python code

student_answer.description: Student's verbal explanation and conceptual reasoning

target_concept.description: Core computer science concept evaluated by this question

answer_correctness.description: Factual and conceptual correctness of the student answer

answer_completeness.description: Completeness of the conceptual coverage in the answer

reasoning_quality.description: Quality and depth of logical reasoning exhibited

identified_misconception.description: Specific conceptual flaw or 'None' if understanding is demonstrated

annotation_confidence.description: Confidence score of the annotation assessment
